bio: Having taken over Katseveer, chef Leon Vermaire and maître d' and sommelier Paul Labruijere are steadily finding their feet. For many years, they have been working at this restaurant that showcases the best of what Eastern Scheldt has to offer. This former ferry waiting room commands stunning views of passing ships and the surrounding countryside.Zeeland produce reigns supreme in chef Vermaire's culinary world. Whether Zeeland venison or North Sea crab, top-notch, locally sourced ingredients play the starring role. His dishes – often really creative – are beautifully crafted and frequently use acidic Asian flavours for that fresh twist....
